div.div:
Temporal (#6)
JobWorkflow starts run_task on queue
dsy-compile, dsy-simulate or dsy-aggregate,
with an optional run prefix in front and never a build id
one attempt per activity, the workflow owns every retry
start-to-close and heartbeat timeouts from pools.yaml

<pool>-worker pod in dsy-workers: python -m dsy_worker --pool <pool>
requests = limits = the slot, one task at a time (max_concurrent_activities 1), no database
